about: Privacy, security, anonymity, systems and automation are the things I keep coming back to.
I like understanding what actually happens underneath the interface — especially where identity, trust and assumptions begin to leak.
Browsers, networks, cryptography, low-level behavior, infrastructure and obsessive experimentation are usually where that curiosity takes me.

projects.name: THOTH Browser
projects.summary: Browser architecture focused on isolation, anti-correlation thinking and a much higher privacy standard.

projects.name: RelayX
projects.summary: A relay-oriented project built around stronger separation, cleaner routing logic and privacy-minded design.
